tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Verdanta AgriTech** builds a precision-agriculture platform used by large farming cooperatives. Sensor stations installed across fields report soil moisture, temperature, and equipment telemetry to the cloud.

**Current Environment:**
- 400,000 sensor stations transmit readings every 30 seconds, producing roughly 2 TB of telemetry per day
- An agronomy analytics team runs interactive dashboards that slice weeks of telemetry by time window, field, and sensor type, expecting sub-second responses
- A separate customer-facing web API serves each cooperative's own field configuration documents (crop plans, irrigation schedules) — a read-heavy JSON workload with users in Europe, South America, and Australia

tabs.title: Technical Requirements
tabs.content:
**Platform Requirements:**
- Telemetry ingestion must sustain millions of events per minute without losing data during downstream slowdowns
- Raw telemetry must be automatically archived to low-cost object storage for later batch reprocessing, without writing custom archiving code
- The analytics store must be optimized for high-volume time-series ingestion and fast aggregations over time windows
- The configuration document store must serve reads in each user geography with single-digit-millisecond latency
- After a cooperative updates an irrigation schedule, that cooperative's own users must always see their change immediately (read-your-own-writes), but other regions may lag slightly
- Operational overhead must be minimized — the platform team is small and prefers managed services
